verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no published region list and no per-region service availability matrix or lookup. One release note mentions a single service in one region (UAE Central), which shows region-scoped rollout but not a list a buyer can check before committing. Community remarks about 'any region globally' are anecdotal and not a published list.

support.subject: As an operations lead, I can pick where things run — a published region list with per-region service availability I can check before committing
